body:
Founder real-time: 'build it with parena wasm' -- resolves the room-engine architecture question in favor of browser/PARENA-WASM. New PARENA/stdlib/mixforge/room.prn (next-seat wrapping turn order, is-valid-seat bounds check, max-seats). New MIXFORGE/scripts/build_room_wasm.sh mirrors PARENA's own make wasm-smoke recipe. New web/index.html -- real, live, clickable 4-seat room UI loading room.wasm directly, no mock. web/room_smoke_test.mjs: 9 real WebAssembly.instantiate assertions, all pass. Honest, not done: no multiplayer room state, no synced audio (Phase 5 media/stream.prn still design-only), no track queue, no key/BPM display -- turn-order rule + compiler pipeline proven live, not a multiplayer room yet. PARENA commit b98bfaf, MIXFORGE commit a66e70b, both pushed.

⚓ ☃
title: First real DJ-room slice shipped: PARENA compiled to WASM, live in a browser
